critical_code_review_comments: web_panel/src/components/customer/Subscriptions.jsx downloadInvoice() awaits the API then calls window.open. In stricter popup-blocker environments (some Chromium builds, Safari) window.open after an await can be blocked because the user-gesture chain is broken. Playwright's chromium DID open the popup here, but consider pre-opening a blank tab before await (const win=window.open('about:blank','_blank'); win.location=... after fetch) as a hardening measure.
backend/controllers/subscription_controller.py::_activate silently swallows invoice generation errors ('except Exception: pass'). Lazy generation covers this, but log the exception for observability.
